review_scope: Independent source and focused-test review of the owned CDP endpoint diagnostic; no native browser, authentication, build, database, or release run.
verdict_A_reason: connectOwnedCdp attaches fixed boundary/reason and shape fields to each endpoint refusal. The native startup catch calls safeEndpointDiagnostic and adds the validated result to BROWSER_STARTUP_FAILURE. The read and record-validation branches are covered by real filesystem tests. An actual native startup report has not yet been observed.
verdict_B_reason: The producer includes no endpoint bytes, port, browser identifier, path, or read error text. The sink whitelists fixed boundary/reason values and exact primitive shape fields, discarding malicious extra keys and raw strings. The original refusal message, endpoint deadline and polling, profile preexistence check, SingletonLock/process verification, and later owned-browser assertions remain in place.

evidence.filesystem_guard: tests/browser/vault-owned-cdp-diagnostic.test.cjs:30-99 covers unreadable path, incomplete then complete record reaching owner refusal, out-of-range port, and foreign browser path.
evidence.malicious_input_guard: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.test.mjs:221-250 checks extra raw fields, unlisted reason, nonnumeric lineCount, and unrelated failure code.

limitations: The retained original admin failure lacks the endpoint branch and cannot be recovered from timing or DevTools listening alone. The next resource-admitted native run must use this unchanged reviewed source to establish the actual branch; this review makes no product-fix or live-launch claim.
